summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration efforts with Spark, including variant support and DSv2 API upgrades. Additionally, there are ongoing conversations about optimizing GitHub Actions usage and enhancing the MetricsReporter with OpenTelemetry support.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes detail integration efforts and bug fixes.
Proposal to integrate OpenTelemetry MetricsReporter into iceberg-core.
Discussions on reducing GitHub Actions consumption due to high usage.
Ongoing talks about column update file representation and metadata.
